quote: DYNAMIC_ROUTE_PATH_PARAMS contains plugin, so this filter emits /plugin/. A navigation to a registered standalone endpoint such as /plugin/secure/report during an outage consequently receives the Control UI shell.
note: The open Before merge item “Exclude the singular plugin HTTP namespace from fallback” identified the faulty /plugin/ prefix and the resulting shell substitution during an outage. No human comment in the bundle answered it.
